cases.title: Meridian Industrials Pension Analysis
cases.background: Analyst Lena Fischer is assessing the impact of Meridian Industrials' (which reports under IFRS) defined benefit pension plan on its financial statements. She has compiled the plan's data for the current year (Exhibit 1) and notes that the company discloses a discount rate of 5.0% and an actual return on plan assets of 63. Fischer wants to determine how the expense is allocated between P&L and OCI.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1. DB Plan Data for the Current Year (in millions)

questions.los: DB计划: PBO构成与变动 (service cost, interest cost, benefits paid)
questions.stem: Based on Exhibit 1 (no actuarial changes), the ending PBO is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。期末 PBO = 期初 + service cost + interest cost − benefits paid = 1200 + 60 + 1200×5% − 40 = 1,280。
explanations.B: 错。1,320 = 1200+60+60,漏减了 benefits paid 40——支付福利同时减少义务和资产。
explanations.C: 错。1,220 = 1200+60−40,漏了 interest cost(期初 PBO×折现率)——义务会随时间推移增值。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: Ending PBO = Beginning PBO + service cost + interest cost − benefits paid (± actuarial changes)

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: The base for interest cost is the beginning PBO; benefits paid must be subtracted—the two omitted items correspond exactly to choices B/C.

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employment Compensation, PBO roll-forward calculation

questions.los: IFRS vs US GAAP: periodic pension cost 三成分归属 (P&L vs OCI)
questions.stem: Under IFRS, the pension expense recognized in P&L for the current year is closest to:

explanations.A: 对。IFRS P&L = service cost + net interest = 60 + (1200−900)×5% = 60 + 15 = 75。net interest 对净负债用同一折现率。
explanations.B: 错。57 = 60 + 60 − 63,把资产端用了实际回报(或 US GAAP 的 expected return 思路)——IFRS 只允许折现率。
explanations.C: 错。120 = 60 + 60,只算了义务的 interest cost,漏了计划资产产生的利息收入抵减。

steps.label: Formula
steps.content: IFRS P&L expense = service cost + (beginning PBO − beginning plan assets) × discount rate

steps.label: Trap
steps.content: Under IFRS the return on assets in P&L is computed using only the discount rate; the difference between this and the actual return goes to OCI.

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employment Compensation, IFRS periodic pension cost

questions.los: IFRS vs US GAAP: periodic pension cost 三成分归属 (P&L vs OCI)
questions.stem: The difference of 18 between the actual return on plan assets of 63 and the interest income on plan assets recognized in P&L should, under IFRS, be:

choices.A: recognized in OCI (as a remeasurement), with no subsequent amortization back to P&L
choices.C: recognized in OCI, with the portion exceeding the corridor amortized back to P&L

explanations.A: 对。实际回报 63 − 900×5%=45 的差额 18 属于 remeasurement,IFRS 下进 OCI 且永不 recycle。
explanations.B: 错。进 P&L 的资产回报只有按折现率计的 45;差额留在 OCI,避免波动污染利润表。
explanations.C: 错。corridor 摊销是 US GAAP 的选择性处理;IFRS 不允许摊回。

questions.source: CFA L2 Curriculum, Employment Compensation, allocation of remeasurements
